title: FARL: A Fully Automated Pipeline of RL Interface and Solver Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.15691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing reinforcement learning (RL) largely focuses on optimizing learning algorithms within a pre-defined task formulation, while applying RL to new tasks still relies heavily on human expertise to design the learning pipeline: what an agent observes, how it is rewarded, which algorithm it uses, and how training is configured. Automating these choices is challenging because they are tightly coupled. We introduce FARL (Fully Automated Reinforcement Learning), a framework that automates RL design by jointly searching observation and reward programs, learning algorithms, and training settings. FARL uses training statistics and observed behavior to diagnose failures, propose changes, and test whether they improve learning. Its search preserves diverse candidates and the controls needed for these tests, using a staged budget to screen designs before investing in longer training. translated_title: FARL：一种完全自动化的强化学习接口与求解器设计流水线
translated_abstract: 现有的强化学习（RL）研究大多侧重于在预先定义的任务形式内优化学习算法，而将强化学习应用于新任务仍然严重依赖人类专业知识来设计学习流程：智能体观察什么、如何获得奖励、使用哪种算法，以及如何配置训练。实现这些选择的自动化极具挑战性，因为它们之间是紧密耦合的。我们提出了FARL（Fully Automated Reinforcement Learning，完全自动化强化学习），这是一个通过联合搜索观测与奖励程序、学习算法和训练设置来自动化强化学习设计的框架。FARL利用训练统计信息和观察到的行为来诊断失败、提出修改方案，并测试这些修改能否改善学习效果。其搜索过程保留了多样化的候选方案以及这些测试所需的控制手段，并采用分阶段预算，在投入更长时间的训练之前先筛选设计方案。实验记忆将每项发现与其相关内容记录在一起（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FARL框架通过联合搜索观测与奖励设计、学习算法和训练设置，并利用训练诊断机制进行迭代改进，实现了强化学习流程的全自动化设计。
en_tdlr: FARL is a framework that fully automates RL pipeline design by jointly searching over observation and reward programs, learning algorithms, and training settings, using training diagnostics to iteratively propose and validate improvements.
